evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises no concerns requiring follow-up. Customer says 'No, no' when asked about concerns initially, so N/A credit applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection. Customer had no concerns to reflect back, so N/A credit applies.

evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' Not asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says 'I truly believe that we're the best move-in town and would you like our help with your upcoming move?' — asked plainly with no built-in out. Full explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states: 'there's no deposit required, no rest in securing your spot. If something comes up and things changes in your end then you can always reschedule or cancel.' Rate lock / no-deposit language present.

Customer says 'Okay' but rep moves forward without confirming readiness. Partial credit.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda_detail: Rep asks 'And do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call?' AFTER customer has already proactively asked about rates ('Could you tell me what your rates are?'). Probing has begun. Asked after probing starts.

top_strength: Excellent logistics detail gathering — rep covered all seven logistics items (property type, floors, rooms, walking distances, access concerns, special items, and box count) with clarity and specificity, building a solid foundation for the estimate.
coaching_note: Section 1 quid pro quo must include the explicit 'Does that sound good to you?' closing with a pause for a yes, not just the time frame and promise — and Their Agenda must be asked before any probing about rates or specifics begins, to set priorities early.
